item.title: Tarragon-Turkey Soup
item.description: This is a quick, yummy soup perfect for a cool evening.

item.title: Red Lentil Soup
item.description: This smooth red lentil soup is a spicy Lebanese-style dish packed with red lentils, onion, and garlic and flavored with cumin, lemon, and cilantro.

item.title: Peanut Soup
item.description: An interesting and nutty soup that's also very rich.

item.title: Easy Chourico Soup
item.description: Dried Portuguese chourico (or "Soyrizo™", for vegetarians) gives a spicy and rich flavor to this exciting and colorful soup made with garbanzo beans, sweet potato, and fresh spinach.

item.title: Creamy Roasted Cauliflower Soup
item.description: This roasted cauliflower soup recipe with garlic, shallots, thyme, and heavy cream is easy to make, comforting, and sure to become a fall favorite.

item.title: Cream of Asparagus Soup
item.description: This asparagus soup is super easy to make with fresh asparagus, broth, sour cream, and a squeeze of lemon for a creamy, silky smooth spring soup.

item.title: Chef John's Cream of Asparagus Soup
item.description: This ultra-easy and gorgeously colored cream of asparagus soup is easy to make for a delicious way to celebrate the first tender spears of the season.

item.title: Caldo De Pollo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
item.description: This Mexican chicken soup, or caldo de pollo, is a simple chicken soup served over spiced rice and topped with avocado slices and cilantro for a hearty meal.

item.title: Butternut Squash and Turnip Soup
item.description: This spiced-up soup is naturally sweet and chock full of flavorful veggies. Leave it chunky, or puree it for a smooth soup. It's a tasty way to warm up on a chilly day.

item.title: French Onion Soup VII
item.description: Onions are caramelized in butter, then combined with broth and white wine for a quick and simple onion soup.

item.title: Jana's Pressure Cooker Lentil Ham Soup
item.description: Create a ham broth, pan-fry some fresh vegetables, and cook a lentil and ham soup all in an hour with a pressure cooker.

item.title: Sweet Lentil Soup with Asparagus Tips
item.description: Lentils are simmered with roasted garlic and red bell pepper, carrot, onion, asparagus tips and peas and seasoned with curry powder, marmalade and saffron in this thick, sweet soup.

item.title: Creamy Shrimp Bisque
item.description: This creamy shrimp bisque recipe simmers shrimp shells and spices in a thick seafood stock, seasoned with paprika, tomato paste, cream, and sherry.

item.title: Matzo Ball Soup
item.description: This Jewish matzo ball soup is made from scratch with a whole chicken, broth, and fluffy matzo balls for a perfect Passover meal or cozy soup anytime!

item.title: Smokey Butternut Squash Soup
item.description: Enjoy the spicy, smokey flavor of this butternut squash soup topped with pomegranate seeds, goat cheese, and crispy Brussels sprouts.

item.title: Pota Brata (Irish Flag Soup)
item.description: Carrots, onions, and celery give the colors of the Irish flag, as well as providing the heart of this simple soup.

item.title: French Onion Soup IX
item.description: Thickly sliced onions are slowly cooked in butter, then combined with beef broth and Romano cheese before being ladled into bowls, and topped with toast and cheese.

item.title: Hearty Italian Lentil Soup
item.description: My mom used to make this during cold winter nights to warm us up. Now I make it all the time because it not only warms you up, it soothes the soul. This recipe is perfect for using up leftover rice and pasta sauce. You can change the recipe to suit your tastes; use your favorite jarred sauce if you don't have any homemade, or use your own family's meatball recipe!

item.title: Quick Creamy Zucchini Soup
item.description: This creamy zucchini soup recipe is lightly seasoned with basil and black pepper. Get it on your table in about half an hour for a tasty, squash-filled bowl of heartwarming goodness.
